name: neg-table-only
description: Movie (MOV/H.264) bitrates up: 1080 Fine 20 -> 32 Mb/s, 1080 Normal 17 -> 24, 720 Fine 13 -> 20, 720 Normal 10 -> 16; VGA (4 Mb/s) and AVCHD unchanged. Not camera-tested. Analysis: experiments/2026-11-12-hardware/06-bitrate-and-limit.md. Changes, block-0 offset = runtime - 0x7E421020: (1) 0x2CD563 = 0x7E6EE583, bitrate table 0x7E6EE4A2, MOV q6 Fine `mov 20000000,d0` -> `mov 32000000,d0`; the request block writes it as both peak (0xA0753564, ulMaxBitrate) and average (0xA0753568, ulBitRate). (2) 0x2CD56B = 0x7E6EE58B, MOV q6 Normal 17000000 -> 24000000. (3) 0x2CD57A = 0x7E6EE59A, MOV q3 Fine 13000000 -> 20000000. (4) 0x2CD582 = 0x7E6EE5A2, MOV q3 Normal 10000000 -> 16000000. (5) 0xA823AB = 0x7EEA33CB, encoder parameter check 0x7EEA338C `cmp 24000000,d0` (peak, rejected when above) -> `cmp 50000000,d0`; H.264 High@4.1 allows 62.5 Mb/s; AVCHD's 24 M peak still passes. (6)-(9) time-limit routine 0x7E6EDE08, its own rates in 512-byte sectors/s, ceil(bitrate/4096) as in stock, so the 4 GiB stop (8388608 sectors) follows the new table: (6) 0x2CCE99 = 0x7E6EDEB9 MOV q6 Fine `mov 4883,d0` -> `mov 7813,d0`; (7) 0x2CCEA3 = 0x7E6EDEC3 q6 Normal 4151 -> 5860; (8) 0x2CCEAA = 0x7E6EDECA q3 Fine 3174 -> 4883; (9) 0x2CCEB4 = 0x7E6EDED4 q3 Normal 2442 -> 3907. All `mov imm16,d0` (sign-extended; every value < 32768). 4 GiB stop with 832 reserve + 375 audio sectors/s: 1080 Fine 1024 s, 1080 Normal 1345 s, 720 Fine 1595 s, 720 Normal 1958 s (so the 1740 s cap binds), VGA 6202 s. Derived encoder fields follow the table average: target kb/s, HRD bit_rate/cpb_size (kb/s - 1, scaled x1024: 32,768,000 for 1080 Fine), and the >= 15.5 M / >= 20 M / >= 14 M classes (720 modes and 1080 Normal change class). Applies with movie-qp-floor-16.json and movie-rec-limit.json (no shared bytes). Restore = stock v1.6.
